title: Run_State deep-copy mirror lives in the view layer; core owns the lifetime pair but not the clone
evidence: app/render/spawn_fx.odin:173: `shadow_clone :: proc(src: ^pp.Run_State, allocator := context.allocator) -> pp.Run_State {` vs core/types.odin:589 `run_init :: proc(state: ^Run_State, seed: u64, catalog_hash: u64, logic_hz: i32,` and core/types.odin:611 `run_destroy :: proc(state: ^Run_State) {`. Recurrence evidence in the same file: `// v2-network-units: the tx window ring is step()-touched (bundles_rebuild resizes it, flow_step writes it) — a shadow that skipped it would carry the LIVE state's data pointers and corrupt it on resize/delete (the shadow-steps + destroy pattern).` and `// ^ THE 2026-08-28 PLAYTEST ABORT (job packet-plumber-v2-box-crash-third- spawn): the Box (#107) shipped without these two lines`
detail: This is the third same-class patch to a hand-mirrored list a core-side contributor has no reason to know exists (#107's Box author edited core only). Mirror ownership is in the wrong package.
recommended_fix: Follow-up: move the deep copy into core as run_clone beside run_init/run_destroy (same package as the struct it mirrors), keeping shadow_clone as the view-layer prediction wrapper.

title: The alias gate is a manually-synced checklist, not an automatic invariant
detail: Completeness depends on the same developer memory that failed in shadow_clone: a new array missed in both lists and empty in the fixtures stays invisible to CI. type_info_of is unused in the repo, but a reflective walk over Run_State would enforce it automatically.
recommended_fix: Add a reflective enumeration of Run_State's [dynamic] fields (recursing nested structs) asserting every field non-aliases, replacing the per-field pin list.

title: sfx_no_alias skips len-0 headers, but length-0 arrays with capacity still alias live data
detail: A missed empty-but-capacitized field aliases a non-nil live buffer; the skip passes it, and clone destroy frees live memory the sim still appends to — silent use-after-free.
recommended_fix: Skip only when raw_data(a) == nil && raw_data(b) == nil; otherwise assert raw_data inequality — strictly stronger and safe since clone_dyn of empties yields nil.
